item.title: Spanberger orders termination of ICE agreements with law enforcement
item.description: Gov. Abigail Spanberger (D) has ordered the termination of U.S. Customs and Immigration Enforcement (ICE) agreements with law enforcement on Wednesday in an attempt to establish principles for agencies and divisions.

item.title: Richmond school community urges support for immigrant families amid ICE concerns
item.description: Richmond parents, teachers and community members are raising concerns about ongoing Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) activity and its impact on families within the Richmond Public Schools (RPS) district.

item.title: Northern Virginian sick with measles, 5th case in just over a month
item.description: A Northern Virginia resident is sick with measles, marking the fifth such sickness Virginia has seen in just over a month. As they visited several Fairfax County places while ill, anyone who also visited those places around the same times may be at risk.

item.title: Trailblazing Richmond-area doctor, civic leader Frank Spencer Royal, Sr. has died
item.description: Dr. Frank Spencer Royal, Sr., a trailblazing Richmond-area doctor and civic leader, passed away on Monday after decades of service to the community.

item.title: Petersburg School Board approves new 5-year strategic plan
item.description: The Petersburg City Public Schools board approved its new five year strategic plan for the district on Wednesday.

item.title: Armed and dangerous Henrico man wanted for child sex crimes
item.description: An armed and dangerous man is wanted in connection with a Henrico County sexual battery case involving a child.

item.title: Richmond doctor pleads guilty to injecting patients with ozone gas, many without consent
item.description: A Richmond doctor has pleaded guilty after he injected several patients -- many of them unknowingly -- with ozone gas, claiming this unauthorized treatment would help with pain.

item.title: LIST: Central Virginia schools going virtual, delayed on Thursday due to icy roads
item.description: Some Central Virginia school districts will be closed, shift to virtual learning or operate on a two-hour delay on Thursday due to dangerous roads from lingering winter storm impacts.

item.description: Very Low snowfall accumulations possible tonight

item.title: 'It's so much damage': Thieves steal Henrico man's Corvette, leaving 20K in damages
item.description: A Henrico man's beloved Corvette was egged, spray-painted, and damaged after police said it was stolen from his parking lot.
